utah-democratic-party.description: Utah’s Democratic Party organizes candidates, volunteers, and voters for elections across the state.

utah-republican-party.description: Utah’s Republican Party organizes candidates, local party organizations, and voters for elections across the state.

utah-constitution-party.description: A Utah political party that nominates candidates under the Constitution Party name.

green-party-of-utah.description: Utah’s Green Party organizes candidates and supporters for participation in state and local elections.

independent-american-party.description: A recognized Utah political party that fields candidates under the Independent American Party name.

utah-libertarian-party.description: Utah’s Libertarian Party organizes candidates and supporters for participation in elections across the state.

forward-party-of-utah.description: A Utah political party formed through the 2025 merger of the Utah Forward Party and United Utah Party.

peoples-freedom-party.description: A recognized Utah political party listed in the state’s official political-party directory.

united-utah-party.description: A former Utah political party whose members approved merging with the Utah Forward Party in 2025. Its earlier candidates remain in this archive.

pinecone.description: One of Fruit Heights’ two local, nonpartisan nominating caucuses for municipal candidates. It is separate from national political parties.

sagebrush.description: One of Fruit Heights’ two local, nonpartisan nominating caucuses for municipal candidates. It is separate from national political parties.

nonpartisan.description: An election affiliation used for candidates in contests conducted without a political-party nomination, including municipal and judicial elections.

unaffiliated.description: An affiliation for candidates recorded as running without a political-party affiliation. It does not identify a separate party organization.

not-reported.description: The source record did not supply a party affiliation. This label does not establish whether the candidate belonged to a political party.
